List distinct tags used across gournal entries with their counts, optionally filtered by project.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Filter by project name |

## Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tags` | `object[]` | yes |  |
| `tags.tag` | `string` | yes |  |
| `tags.count` | `number` | yes |  |
